apps/api/src/cloudflare-local.ts: Local Cloudflare preparation, run as node apps/api/dist/cloudflare-local.js by scripts/cloudflare.mjs.
apps/api/src/content-sync-cli.ts: Operator content sync, run as node apps/api/dist/content-sync-cli.js in the API container and by scripts/dev-stack.mjs.
apps/api/src/dev.ts: Node development server, started by the apps/api dev script.
apps/api/src/dispatcher.ts: Outbox dispatcher process, the dispatcher service command in docker-compose.yml and the generated project.
apps/api/src/production.ts: Production API process, the apps/api Dockerfile CMD.
apps/builder/src/main.ts: Builder process, started by the apps/builder start script and Dockerfile.
packages/platform-node/src/migrate.ts: Migration executable, run as node dist/migrate.js by the Compose files, the generated project and release images.
